model_family: item-item cooccurrence cosine/jaccard with ALS/popularity rank fusion
validation: same two chronological folds, same lowest xxhash64(int visitorid,42) 1000-user cohorts; all cold users retained
selection: maximize minimum of three mean-validation metric ratios vs fixed popularity-7d baseline; ties by NDCG, recall, precision; baseline included
promotion_gate: chosen configuration must strictly beat baseline on all three mean-validation metrics AND all three primary-test metrics; no alternative selection from test; otherwise retain previous active demo
uncertainty: paired user bootstrap 95% interval, 1000 resamples, fixed seed 42; no claim of independent future-period testing
policy: If the frozen test fails, report failure; no further tuning against this test in this experiment.
